decisions.statement: The file has every refusal the last audit this agent ran answered with.
One blank line parts two refusals.
An audit replaces the file rather than appending to the file.
An audit refusing nothing takes the file away.
A landing this agent makes leaves the file as the last audit left it.
The file is kept outside the commit.
The byte ceiling is judged over no file here.
No author writes a line here by hand.

definition: what the last audit an agent ran refused
